summary: CR-2026-10-03-001 (delete dead customer API shim) verified end-to-end. Ran the pre-existing smoke test (12/12 passing) and added a complementary test file covering every item in the review request — deleted-route 404s without auth, admin login shape (token/pos_token/no restaurant_context), /api/auth/me, wrong-password 401, unknown-email 404 with 'Account not found', public routes untouched (/healthz, /config/478, /dietary-tags/478), /api/config/689 GET, admin PUT /api/config/ round-trip + restore on restaurant 478, and backend.err.log clean since last startup. Combined suite: 28/28 passed. Broader regression (/app/backend/tests/smoke + /app/backend/tests/contracts) also passes 61/61 after cleanup. Login rate limit (5/min) respected throughout — admin JWT fixture reused and extras tested in a single window.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/config/ ignores any `restaurant_id` in the request body — it always writes to the restaurant baked into the admin JWT. Not a CR regression (behaviour predates this change), but worth documenting as it is non-obvious and caused one of my test iterations to silently succeed against the wrong restaurant.
test_credentials: owner@18march.com / Qplazm@10 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and conftest ADMIN_PHONE/ADMIN_PASS env defaults)
seed_data_creation: None. Config round-trip test writes a timestamped marker to restaurant 478's welcomeMessage and restores the original value in the same test. After an earlier dry-run where the marker leaked (double-execution), I manually PUT welcomeMessage='Welcome!' to clean up; confirmed by rerunning tests/contracts/test_public_config.py (9/9 pass incl. snapshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything related to CR-2026-10-03-001 is green. The new extras file /app/backend/tests/smoke/test_cr_2026_10_03_001_extras.py is a safe long-term regression suite. If re-running: login limiter is 5/min — the extras file consumes 3 login slots (admin_jwt fixture + wrong-password + unknown-email); the companion test_cr_2026_10_03_001.py consumes 2 more (admin_jwt reused via session scope + test_admin_login_still_restaurant). Running both together is fine (admin_jwt is session-scoped). Running them back-to-back across sessions needs a 60s pause.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor test authoring note: initial version of my config round-trip test targeted restaurant 689 using the body `restaurant_id` field; backend ignores that field and keys off the JWT's restaurant_id, so the PUT silently wrote to 478 and the GET on 689 showed no change. Fixed by aligning the test to the admin's actual restaurant (478) and keeping a plain GET /api/config/689 assertion to prove the public read route still works.
